jaxp_enable_extension_functions.description: Determines whether XSLT and XPath extension functions are allowed.

jaxp_override_default_parser.description: Allows a third party implementation to override the default parser provided by the JDK.

jaxp_jdkcatalog_resolve.description: Instructs the JDK default CatalogResolver to act in accordance with the setting when unable to resolve an external reference. Options: continue, ignore, strict.

jaxp_dtd_support.description: Instructs the parsers to deny, ignore or allow DTD processing. Options: deny, ignore, allow.

jaxp_entity_expansion_limit.description: Limits the number of entity expansions.

jaxp_total_entity_size_limit.description: Limits the total size of all entities that include general and parameter entities.

jaxp_max_general_entity_size_limit.description: Limits the maximum size of any general entities.

jaxp_max_parameter_entity_size_limit.description: Limits the maximum size of any parameter entities.

jaxp_entity_replacement_limit.description: Limits the total number of nodes in all entity references.

jaxp_element_attribute_limit.description: Limits the number of attributes an element can have.

jaxp_max_occur_limit.description: Limits the number of content model nodes that may be created when building a grammar for a W3C XML Schema.

jaxp_max_xml_name_limit.description: Limits the maximum size of XML names.

jaxp_xpath_expr_grp_limit.description: Limits the number of groups an XPath expression can contain.

jaxp_xpath_expr_op_limit.description: Limits the number of operators an XPath expression can contain.

jaxp_xpath_total_op_limit.description: Limits the total number of XPath operators in an XSL Stylesheet.
